WITH riq_data AS (
    SELECT 
        d.makername,
        d.modnum,
        t.devscope,
        r.rgbbright,
        r.rgbcoloracc,
        r.rgbzones,
        ROUND(CAST((r.rgbbright::numeric / 100.0) * (r.rgbcoloracc / 10.0) * (0.5 + r.rgbzones::numeric / 20.0) AS numeric), 2) AS riq_score,
        CASE 
            WHEN (r.rgbbright::numeric / 100.0) * (r.rgbcoloracc / 10.0) * (0.5 + r.rgbzones::numeric / 20.0) > 8.0 THEN 'Premium RGB Implementation'
            WHEN (r.rgbbright::numeric / 100.0) * (r.rgbcoloracc / 10.0) * (0.5 + r.rgbzones::numeric / 20.0) BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.0 THEN 'High-Quality RGB'
            WHEN (r.rgbbright::numeric / 100.0) * (r.rgbcoloracc / 10.0) * (0.5 + r.rgbzones::numeric / 20.0) BETWEEN 3.0 AND 5.9 THEN 'Standard RGB'
            ELSE 'Basic RGB'
        END AS riq_classification
    FROM rgb r
    JOIN mechanical m ON r.rgbmechref = m.mechregistry
    JOIN deviceidentity d ON m.mechdevref = d.devregistry
    JOIN testsessions t ON d.devsessionref = t.sessionregistry
)
SELECT 
    riq_classification,
